text_block_list.text:
On the way back from an outing with 
Maruzensky...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh? I had no idea there was a rental car 
shop in a place like that.

At the end of her gaze was a rental car 
shop lined with various kinds of vehicles.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I've got Tacchan with me, so I never 
really paid it much mind.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: A rental car, huh...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: ...That's it!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-kun, wanna rent a car and go 
for a drive?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer-chan, wanna rent a car and go 
for a drive?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I just thought it'd be nice to go 
for a drive with you at the wheel for 
once, Trainer-kun♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I just thought it'd be nice to go 
for a drive with you at the wheel for 
once, Trainer-chan♪

It was a bit surprising. Whenever we go 
for a drive she always insists on driving, 
so I assumed she never wanted to give up 
the steering wheel...
choice_data_list: Is it okay if I drive?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Abso-tootly-lutely!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course I love driving, but I enjoy just 
being a passenger just as much.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Going on all sorts of trips with Dad 
driving is really where my love for 
driving began!
choice_data_list:
...Could that be where your love of speed 
comes from?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bingo! Guess you could say it's a trait I 
inherited from my dad♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My dad's driving felt like an amusement 
park ride—it was more fun than any other 
entertainment~

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I kinda liked traffic jams too. It 
meant we had that much more time to chat, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"When it's a drive with someone precious 
to you, just riding together is pure 
bliss, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So... I was thinking of letting you take 
the wheel, Trainer-kun~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So... I was thinking of letting you take 
the wheel, Trainer-chan~?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to see how she drives~

text_block_list.text:

watching over you from behind!

text_block_list.text:

watching over you from behind!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Whew♪ Now that's a speed I absolutely 
love!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just keep going and blast right on 
through~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Phew~, that felt amazing! The wind was 
whipping right in from behind too!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's my partner for ya! That was some 
wild drivin'~!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Let's high five, high five!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yay!☆

Driving to match Maruzensky's preferences 
made her extremely happy.

text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer-kun♪ I'll be

text_block_list.text:

text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, we're stuck in traffic. Looks 
like this is gonna take a while~.
choice_data_list: Then we'll have plenty of time to talk.
Then we'll have plenty of time to talk.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
...Ah~, I see♪ Because I said I liked 
traffic jams too...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, what a clever arrangement. Let's 
talk to our hearts' content just as you 
wished, shall we?♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Phew... It's gotten completely dark out, 
hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Still, we chatted about so many silly 
little things... I enjoyed myself plenty.”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Plus, I got to gaze at Trainer-kun's back 
a whole bunch... just kidding♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I got to stare at your back a whole lot 
too, Trainer-chan... Just kidding♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
For now, I'll keep my eyes fixed straight 
on you.

text_block_list.text: Fufu...♪

"...And so, while gazing out at the sea 
for a while, I continued chatting with 
Maruzensky."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer-kun♪ I'll be 
watching over you from behind!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you, Trainer-chan♪ I'll be

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... quite the laid-back one, aren't 
you? The complete opposite of my driving 
style.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still... in a way, it's kind of a 
relief...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: …………――*inhale*

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"...S-Sorry, okay? I dozed off for a bit 
there."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Your driving was so gentle, Trainer-kun... 
It made me feel so safe, I guess I just 
dozed off.
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to relax.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Your driving was so gentle, 
Trainer-chan... I guess it just put me at 
ease."
choice_data_list: I'm glad you were able to relax.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it was so relaxing. It really took 
me back to my childhood.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"I realized that taking it easy once in a 
while isn't so bad after all."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: —Leave the ride back to me, though!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'll give you a ride that'll wake you 
right up!

It turned into a drive where we could 
enjoy both peaceful moments and maddening 
speeds...
